title: Submit onboarding request
instruction: Create an onboarding request for Maya Ortiz using maya.ortiz@example.com, role Designer, start date 2026-06-15, and notes that include Figma access. Submit the request.

title: Find approved desk gear
instruction: Search or filter the catalog to find an in-stock Office item rated at least 4.5 stars, then select the Adjustable Laptop Stand.
successCriteria: selected product rating is at least 4.5

title: Update workspace settings
instruction: Enable the weekly email digest, keep autosave enabled, turn off product analytics sharing, and set the timezone to America/New_York.

title: Review priority support ticket
instruction: Find Priya Shah's INC-2048 support ticket in the review queue and mark it reviewed.
successCriteria: table query identifies Priya Shah or INC-2048

title: Confirm access request
instruction: Open the confirmation dialog for request REQ-77 and confirm it.

title: Review paginated invoice
instruction: Go to page 2 of the invoice queue and mark invoice INV-203 reviewed.

title: Select highest-risk inventory
instruction: Sort the inventory table by risk descending, then select the Battery Pack Recall Kit.

title: Submit multiple approvals
instruction: Select approvals APR-102 and APR-205 only, then submit the selected approvals.

title: Recover from validation error
instruction: Submit the empty access review form once to show validation, then enter title Quarterly access review, owner Morgan Lee, due date 2026-06-30, and submit successfully.
successCriteria: validation error was shown before successful submit

title: Attach compliance evidence
instruction: Attach security-audit.pdf, set category to Compliance, add description Q2 security audit evidence, and submit the upload request.
successCriteria: description mentions Q2 security audit evidence
